description: Rilevazione sperimentale continua dati di traffico veicolare - Storico is a series of datasets listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. I dati dei flussi di traffico sono stati raccolti da Magenta srl nel corso della sperimentazione condotta con il progetto CHEST/TrafficFlow - co-finanziato nell'ambito dell'iniziativa CAPS della Commissione Europea (programma FP7, Grant nr. 611333). Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are comune-firenze, dati-sensori, mobilita, opendata, trasporto. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
